name: Stonegear's Search
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Pilot Stonegear loves his siege engine, as every pilot should!  And he's always eager to find new ways to improve his tank's firepower!

He heard rumors of a rare ore and is looking for someone to hunt it down for him.  If your boots are starting to itch, then find Stonegear at Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh and see what he wants.
narrative.offerRewardText: Hello adventurer. You're here about the task I have, eh? It's good to see a young friend like yourself whose blood burns at the prospect of adventure!

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 22 to 23, 2,210 XP in all.

quests.name: Search for Incendicite
quests.objectiveText: Bring 6 loads of Incendicite Ore to Pilot Stonegear in Dun Morogh.
